findings.title: Missing React key on GrafanaRuleListItem
findings.body: In the rules.map, the GrafanaRuleListItem branch does not receive the `key` prop that is computed for each rule. The `key` variable is passed to DataSourceRuleLoader and UnknownRuleListItem, but omitted here. This causes React to warn about missing keys and can lead to incorrect DOM reuse and state loss when the list updates or reorders.

findings.title: Delete action hidden for Grafana rules in list view
findings.body: The condition for rendering the Delete menu item is `{canDelete && rulerRule && (` but in the alert list view the `rulerRule` prop is undefined because ruler API requests have been removed. `canDelete` may be true based on the new `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, but the `rulerRule &&` check prevents the Delete item from ever appearing. As a result, users cannot delete Grafana-managed rules from the alert list view, which is a regression from the previous behavior.

findings.title: Pause action hidden for Grafana rules in list view
findings.body: The pause menu item is only rendered when `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` is true. In the alert list view, `rulerRule` is undefined, so even if `canPause` is true via the Grafana Prometheus rule abilities, the pause item is never shown. Users lose the ability to pause/unpause Grafana-managed rules from the list view.

findings.title: Silence drawer never opens for Grafana rules in list view
findings.body: The SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer is only rendered when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true, but in the alert list view the `rule` prop (rulerRule) is undefined. Clicking "Silence notifications" sets `showSilenceDrawer` to true, but the drawer component does not mount because the condition is false. Therefore, the silence action is broken for Grafana-managed rules in the new list view.

findings.title: Transient Creating/Deleting states are no longer shown
findings.body: The component previously fetched both ruler and Prometheus rule groups and displayed rules that existed in only one of the sources as "Creating" or "Deleting" operation items. After this change, only rules present in the Prometheus response are rendered. Rules in the process of being created (exist only in ruler) or deleted (exist only in Prometheus) disappear from the list entirely, causing a brief but user-visible gap and lack of feedback during rule lifecycle transitions.

findings.title: Lost returnTo query parameter in rule detail link
findings.body: The previous GrafanaRuleListItem included a `returnTo` query parameter built with `createReturnTo()` when creating the view link (`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view?returnTo=...`). The new component constructs the href with only the path, omitting `returnTo`. This means that when a user navigates from a filtered alert list to a rule detail view and then uses the back navigation, they may lose the filter and pagination state they came from.

findings.title: Labels may be undefined and cause rendering issues
findings.body: The component destructures `labels` from the Prometheus rule DTO and passes it to `commonProps.labels` without a fallback. In the old implementation, `labels` defaulted to `{}`. If a rule has no labels (the field is optional in `GrafanaPromRuleDTO`), `labels` will be `undefined`, and downstream components that expect a `Labels` object may throw or render incorrectly. This can happen for rules without labels.
